Polyploidy refers to having more than two sets of chromosomes.  
Colchicine is known to inhibit microtubule polymerization by binding to tubulin, which prevents spindle formation during mitosis.  
Without a spindle, chromosomes cannot segregate into daughter cells, but DNA replication can still occur, leading to polyploid cells.  
Penicillin is an antibiotic targeting bacterial cell walls.  
Tetracycline inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.  
Puromycin inhibits protein synthesis in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes by causing premature chain termination.  
Only colchicine directly affects the mitotic spindle to induce polyploidy.  

Final answer: (B)
